errors.evidence: The y-axis has a linear scale, as indicated by the evenly spaced tick marks (0, 1, 2, 3, etc.). The description incorrectly states it is a logarithmic scale.
The description incorrectly assigns the blue line to Austria. In the chart, the line for Austria (Österreich) is green.
The description states that the line for Austria ends at approximately 4.2% in 2020. However, the green line for Austria ends at approximately 2.9%.
The description incorrectly assigns the green line to Germany. In the chart, the line for Germany (Deutschland) is blue.
The description states that the line for Germany starts at approximately 6.3%. The actual line for Germany (the blue one) starts at approximately 3.6% in 2000.
The description claims that the line for Germany decreases over time. However, the blue line for Germany shows a slight increase, from about 3.6% in 2000 to about 3.9% in 2020.
